Method of Attack: Exploitation of a chain of bugs in the Jupyter Notebook feature of Azure Cosmos DB
Remote takeover of other users' databases by gaining full admin access without authorization
Access to other users' Cosmos DB credentials including primary keys
Trivial exploit requiring no previous access to target environment
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Azure customers' databases and accounts
Attack Vector: Vulnerability in Azure Cosmos DB Jupyter Notebook feature enabled by default
Indicators of Compromise: Use of account's primary read-write key to access other customers' resources
Potential unauthorized access to Cosmos DB accounts before feature was disabled
